definitions.explanation: A licensed professional who assists at childbirth and cares for mothers and newborns before and after the birth. The official title since 2002, replacing {助産婦|じょさんぷ}; in Japan the license is open only to women.

examples.japanese: {助産師|じょさんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
{助産師|じょさんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立|た}ち{会|あ}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出産|しゅっさん}した→出産する：26987_shussansuru⟧。
examples.english: She gave birth with a midwife in attendance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{助産婦|じょさんぷ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれていた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{助産師|じょさんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧な⟦{名称|めいしょう}→名称：12031_meishou⟧だ。
examples.english: They used to be called josanpu, but josanshi is now the official title.

notes:
The suffix 〜{師|し} replaced 〜{婦|ふ} (woman) in 2002, as ⟦{看護婦|かんごふ}→看護婦：01380_kangofu⟧ became ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧. Older people and older texts still say {助産婦|じょさんぷ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {助産師|じょさんし}⟦{外来|がいらい}→外来：09895_gairai⟧: a midwife-run clinic at a hospital
- {助産院|じょさんいん}: a midwife's birthing home
- {助産師|じょさんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧: a midwife's license

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{産婦人科|さんふじんか}→産婦人科：16784_sanfujinka⟧{医|い}: an obstetrician-gynecologist (a doctor)
- ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧: a nurse
